defects.what: icon-only settings button: the svg is aria-hidden and the button has no name
pager buttons are 16x16 px and touch each other
defects.check: axe:target-size (a WCAG 2.2 rule, off by default)

defects.what: filter chips remove the focus outline and show nothing else on focus
status is a coloured dot only: no text, no name
'Delete all' empties the table at once: no confirmation, no undo
a 260 px maintenance banner is inserted at the top 600 ms after load and pushes the page down
the Refresh button at the bottom has tabindex=1, so Tab reaches it first, before the search field
defects.check: axe:tabindex (a best-practice rule, on by default); measured:tabStops n=0 is #refresh

defects.what: the page is Bulgarian but <html lang> is en
the heading's first letter is a Latin T, not the Cyrillic Т
the name field has no label: the text above it isn't tied to it, and there's no placeholder or aria-label
the seat choices are divs with onclick: no role, no tabindex, not reachable or choosable by keyboard
a 20:00 countdown auto-submits at zero, with no way to extend or turn it off
a group with no choice is shown only by a red border on submit, with no text
defects.check: step: submit empty, no error text

defects.what: the viewport meta blocks zoom (maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no)
the booking form is a fixed 520 px wide and scrolls sideways at 375 and 320 px
